viz_PkdPdGYv.title: Detection Catalog
viz_PkdPdGYv.description: Lists all observed Suricata detection signatures with key metadata and activity metrics, providing a baseline for detection engineering and rule tuning.

viz_dKge4qJH.title: Top Detection Volume
viz_dKge4qJH.description: Highlights the detection signatures generating the highest alert volume, helping identify noisy rules and prioritize tuning efforts.

viz_gTVLlACS.title: Detection Severity Distribution
viz_gTVLlACS.description: Shows the distribution of detections by severity.

viz_GqdAo2Zx.title: Detection Categories
viz_GqdAo2Zx.description: Breaks down detections by Suricata alert category, helping engineers understand the types of activity being detected.

viz_1qaK6rrH.title: High Volume Rules
viz_1qaK6rrH.description: Identifies detection signatures exceeding a defined alert threshold, helping prioritize high-noise rules for investigation and tuning.

viz_Z4w6VrVM.title: Recently Introduced Detections
viz_Z4w6VrVM.description: Lists recently observed detection signatures to help validate new rules, monitor emerging activity, and track changes in detection coverage.

options.query:
index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert
| stats count earliest(_time) as FirstSeen latest(_time) as LastSeen by alert.signature_id alert.signature alert.category alert.severity
| convert ctime(FirstSeen) ctime(LastSeen)
| sort -count

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert
| top limit=10 alert.signature

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert
| chart count BY alert.severity

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert
| top limit=10 alert.category

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert
| stats count by alert.signature
| where count > 100
| sort -count

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert
| stats earliest(_time) as FirstSeen latest(_time) as LastSeen count by alert.signature
| convert ctime(FirstSeen) ctime(LastSeen)
| sort -LastSeen

description: Provides an inventory of observed Suricata detections, enabling detection engineers to review rule activity, identify noisy or high-value signatures, validate detection coverage, and prioritize tuning efforts based on real telemetry.
title: Detection Inventory
